name: @elizaos/agent-host
description: The Node.js on-device agent host process, PGlite storage, model binding, plugins, bundle builder, tasks and local API.

scripts.sync:gen: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),srcGen=path.resolve('../agent/gen'),dstGen=path.resolve('gen');if(!fs.existsSync(srcGen))throw new Error('packages/agent/gen is missing; run pnpm gen first');const needed=new Set(['package.json']),seen=new Set(),walk=d=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(/\.(?:tsx?|vibe)$/.test(e.name)){for(const m of fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').matchAll(/from\s+['\"]\.{1,3}\/(?:\.\.\/)*gen\/([^'\"]+)['\"]/g))add(m[1]);}}},add=n=>{if(seen.has(n))return;const f=path.join(srcGen,n);if(!fs.existsSync(f))return;seen.add(n);needed.add(n);for(const m of fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').matchAll(/from\s+['\"]\.\/([^'\"]+)['\"]/g))add(m[1]);};walk('src');walk('test');fs.mkdirSync(dstGen,{recursive:true});for(const n of needed){const s=path.join(srcGen,n),d=path.join(dstGen,n),t=fs.readFileSync(s,'utf8');if(!fs.existsSync(d)||fs.readFileSync(d,'utf8')!==t)fs.writeFileSync(d,t);}for(const f of fs.readdirSync(dstGen))if(!needed.has(f))fs.rmSync(path.join(dstGen,f),{recursive:true,force:true});"
scripts.build: pnpm run sync:gen && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && vibelang -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const source=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));const target=value=>value.startsWith('./dist/')?'./'+value.slice(7):value;for(const file of fs.globSync(['src/**/*.sql'])){fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname('dist/'+file),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(file,'dist/'+file);}const publishedExports=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(source.exports).map(([name,conditions])=>[name,Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(conditions).map(([condition,value])=>[condition,target(condition==='eliza-source'?(conditions.import??conditions.default):value)]))]));const publication={...source,main:target(source.main),types:target(source.types),bin:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(source.bin).map(([name,value])=>[name,target(value)])),files:['src','gen'],exports:publishedExports};delete publication.scripts;delete publication.publishConfig;fs.writeFileSync('dist/package.json',JSON.stringify(publication,null,2)+'\n');"
